{{Youmay|the [[Atrisian Empire]] rank|[[Generalissimo]], used by nations past the [[Tarleev]]}}
The '''generalissimi''' was a high rank within the [[Atrisian Empire]], often attributed to warlords. Holders of this rank often used a selfsame appellation of "Warlord of the Empire."

It was rumored that this rank, more specifically the selfsame appellation, had been the inspiration for the title of [[Warlord of the Empire]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
